_comment: Hand-labelled (text, pin) pairs for fitting the negative-pin check's thresholds (issue #232). Built only from the synthetic benchmark profiles in eval/profiles/ (never personal/): every `text` is verbatim from the named profile (a bullet, or an item's company or project name). The pins are synthetic. `label` is the user-confirmed label (reviewed 2026-09-30 from REVIEW.md, every proposed label kept as is): mentions | does_not_mention. `direct` pairs contain the pinned term as a word, the control the term match already catches; every other category has no term match, so a hit there is one only Jev can add. `near_miss` pairs are related to the pinned topic but are not it, and must not block. `negation` pairs have a pin statement that carries a negation or a comparison. `kind` is the state's kind (bullet, or an item field). Regenerate the report with `python eval/fit_negative_pin_threshold.py analyze`.
